text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the fourth corner! The Umamusume 
head into the final stretch!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: This is the end—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey breaks away!! Dream 
Journey!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey is in front!! And crosses 
the finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey is the strongest!!! What an 
unbelievable run!!! Thank you for such an 
emotional race!!!

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That was the best race everrr!!! I love 
you, Dorijaaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Voices from the Venue
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like it pierced straight
through 
my chest— It's burning, almost to the 
point of pain...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Besides, everyone in the venue is deeply 
moved too—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So this is the Takarazuka Kinen...! The 
Grand Prix...! Journey-san's running 
style...!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ah... I understand that all too well...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(...The voices of so many fans, carrying 
heat, forming a swirl, and enveloping the 
venue...—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (Truly, just like a tempest...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Today, I have become truly complete, 
haven't I—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ――Into an Umamusume who is a "storm."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(This feeling welling up in my chest... 
This warmth... this urge...—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Hahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Have I really changed this much...?

text_block_list.name: Fan's Voice
text_block_list.text:
(Congraaaats!! That was so coool!! Dream 
Journeeey!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ――...It is strange.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The scenery from up here looks
brighter... 
than ever before.
choice_data_list: It's because you carried your drea...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By running with her fans in her heart and 
carrying their dreams,
the view of victory 
for Dream Journey must have transformed 
completely...!
choice_data_list: It's because you carried those dre...
It's because you won carrying your...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
......Yes, you're right. ...It must be, 
without a doubt—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (...I remember――)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(The moment Ane-go carried the dreams of 
so many and claimed victory in a Hong
Kong 
GⅠ...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (Is this what Big Sis saw back then, too?)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(It bothers me. ...But right now, more 
than that—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (...I can't resist it.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(To this urge welling up from within 
myself... and gifted to me by the fans—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Right now... how do I look in your eyes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...What's truly needed right now is my 
honest, heartfelt words."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So as their Trainer,
give an honest answer 
based on the impression you remember
right 
now—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
choice_data_list: It looks to me like you're not sat...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...You truly are wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —To everyone who cheered me on!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Today, I shall present to you all yet 
another dream.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...The upcoming year-end Grand Prix, the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I declare right here and now that I will 
aim for that pinnacle. And—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I swear that I shall emerge victorious 
and achieve it. ——Back-to-back Grand Prix 
victories!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...It was just as you saw.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The light in those eyes burns with 
heat, swirling into a tempest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As if answering the crowd's fervor.
...As 
if harboring a storm within—"
choice_data_list: I'll let them dream, and dream wit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The fans, Dream Journey, and 
myself—we're all still dreaming. We still 
want to dream."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This "journey" had surely... become that 
kind of "journey."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...That's my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Takarazuka Kinen finished 
charting a path toward a new dream—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“—Well then, with the Arima Kinen as the 
primary goal, we'll enter the All Comers 
after summer.”
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's check your condition t...
Yeah. Let's check your condition t...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The All Comers is a 2200m turf G2 race 
held at Nakayama Racecourse."
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's test your condition there.
Yeah. We can check your condition ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is an easy gathering point for 
Umamusume aiming for the big autumn
races, 
and is widely treated as an important
race that predicts future performance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want Dream Journey to deliver solid 
results in this All Comers and carry that 
momentum into the Arima Kinen...!
choice_data_list: Let's definitely win and bring the...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu— Understood completely.
choice_data_list: We'll definitely win and fire up o...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I am truly looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ……The road continues.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the dream continues. Therefore, 
the traveler... smiles—
